capability.label: Broadside
capability.meaning: many copies of a flank weapon fire at once, straight out of one side

capability.label: Carrier
capability.meaning: launches and recovers fighters or drones

capability.label: Spinal mount
capability.meaning: one weapon along the keel: slower to fire, far longer reach, much heavier hit
capability.svg: <path d="M2 12 L5 9 H10 L13 12 L10 15 H5 Z"/><path d="M13 12H23" stroke-width="3"/>

capability.label: Heavy mount
capability.meaning: one oversized forward gun in place of several: fewer shots, a much bigger hit, no charge
capability.svg: <path d="M4 16 L7 13 H11 L14 16 L11 19 H7 Z"/><path d="M11 16V4" stroke-width="5"/>

capability.label: Shield projector
capability.meaning: stronger shields, its own or thrown over allies

capability.label: Missile cells
capability.meaning: extra missile slots and seekers that home harder

capability.label: Weapon link
capability.meaning: its weapons also fire from linked ships or virtual copies

capability.label: Repair
capability.meaning: repairs or refits allies in battle

capability.label: Field
capability.meaning: an area drawn on space with a visible windup; everything inside is hit
capability.svg: <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" stroke-dasharray="3 2.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.5"/>

capability.label: Symbiont rounds
capability.meaning: hits that get past the shield poison the crew

capability.label: Time
capability.meaning: stasis fields, and rewinding its own damage

capability.label: Rift
capability.meaning: walls in space ships cannot cross, and portals through it
capability.svg: <ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="9" ry="5"/><ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="4" ry="2"/>

capability.label: Drain
capability.meaning: steals the target's energy into its own banks

weapon.label: Ballistic
weapon.meaning: a solid slug that travels and hits the first thing on its path

weapon.label: Pulse
weapon.meaning: a fast energy bolt fired in short bursts

weapon.label: Plasma
weapon.meaning: a slow, heavy ball of plasma that burns what it hits

weapon.label: Beam
weapon.meaning: a held beam that lands the moment it fires and damages while it stays on

weapon.label: Lance
weapon.meaning: a charged shot that hits everything on its line

weapon.label: Missile
weapon.meaning: a guided seeker that locks its target at launch

weapon.label: Torpedo
weapon.meaning: a slow, heavy warhead for big targets and stations

weapon.label: Chain lightning
weapon.meaning: an instant arc that jumps from the target to the ships near it

weapon.label: Flak
weapon.meaning: a shell that bursts into fragments near small targets

weapon.label: Shard
weapon.meaning: a crystal round that splits into a cone of shards on impact

weapon.label: Ion
weapon.meaning: a charge that hurts shields and systems rather than the hull

weapon.label: Mine
weapon.meaning: a charge left in space that goes off when a ship comes near

weapon.label: Drone
weapon.meaning: launched craft that fly and fight on their own

weapon.label: Ram
weapon.meaning: contact damage from the hull: a prow, saws or jaws

weapon.label: Field
weapon.meaning: an area drawn on space with a long windup; everything inside it is hit
weapon.svg: <path d="M12 3 L21 12 L12 21 L3 12 Z" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/><path d="M9 12h6M12 9v6"/>

gear.label: Shield generator
gear.meaning: a 360 degree bubble that takes hits before armour and hull and recharges from the reactor

gear.label: Barrier generator
gear.meaning: cells outside the ship, each stopping one hit whole; replaced, never repaired

gear.label: Shield projector
gear.meaning: throws half its shield over one ally

gear.label: Armour plating
gear.meaning: bought plating spread across the hull sections, taking what the shield lets through

gear.label: Point defence
gear.meaning: small fast turrets that shoot down missiles, drones and borers

gear.label: EMP
gear.meaning: a pulse around the ship that kills every missile in its radius
gear.svg: <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke-dasharray="1 3"/>

gear.label: ECM
gear.meaning: jammers, chaff and decoys that break locks and fool scans

gear.label: Cloak
gear.meaning: hides the ship from sensors until it fires or the charge runs out

gear.label: Sensors
gear.meaning: radar and scanner: how far the ship sees, and what a scan reveals

gear.label: Boarding pods
gear.meaning: pods that latch on once the shield is down and fight the crew inside; the ship is taken when its crew falls

gear.label: Intrusion
gear.meaning: seizes one of an enemy's systems for a while

gear.label: Tractor beam
gear.meaning: pulls pods, lifeboats or rocks towards the ship

gear.label: Mining laser
gear.meaning: cuts ore out of rock into the hold
gear.svg: <path d="M3 12h9" stroke-width="2.4"/><path d="M14 7 L20 5 L21 12 L19 19 L14 17 Z"/>

gear.label: Repair
gear.meaning: restores hull, plates and systems away from a yard

gear.label: Hangar
gear.meaning: launches, recovers and rearms small craft

gear.label: Cloning bay
gear.meaning: grows spare pilots aboard a carrier using energy and biomass

gear.label: Reactor
gear.meaning: the energy bank every gun, shield and beam draws on

gear.label: Jump drive
gear.meaning: charges, then carries the ship to another sector

gear.label: Cargo hold
gear.meaning: tonnes of room for goods, ore and passengers

gear.label: Lifeboat
gear.meaning: an escape pod that saves the crew when the hull is lost

status.label: Burning
status.meaning: loses hull every second and cannot repair until it goes out

status.label: Frozen
status.meaning: turns and accelerates slower; weapons cool faster

status.label: Shocked
status.meaning: its energy drains, so shields and guns recharge slower

status.label: Poisoned
status.meaning: the crew takes damage past the shield, which helps a capture

status.label: Corroded
status.meaning: one armour plate is eaten away and takes extra damage

status.label: Disabled
status.meaning: a system is knocked out briefly: engines, guns or shields
status.svg: <rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M4 4l16 16"/>

status.label: Stasis
status.meaning: cannot move, fire or be hurt for a few seconds
status.svg: <rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M10 9v6M14 9v6"/>

status.label: Snared
status.meaning: dragged towards a point or slowed by gravity

status.label: Jammed
status.meaning: its target lock is lost and cannot be retaken for a while

status.label: Marked
status.meaning: takes extra damage from everyone the marker fights with

status.label: Hacked
status.meaning: one of its systems obeys the enemy for a while

status.label: Suppressed
status.meaning: its subfaction traits and hull bonuses are switched off

status.label: Overheated
status.meaning: a mount at its heat cap stops firing until it cools to half

status.label: Worn
status.meaning: drive or guns lose condition as hull damage spills inside

defence.label: Barrier
defence.meaning: the outermost layer: cells outside the ship, each stopping one hit whole; replaced, never repaired

defence.label: Shield
defence.meaning: the 360 degree bubble a shield generator raises; takes damage before armour and hull and recharges
defence.svg: <path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 1 18 0"/><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 0 18 0" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/><rect x="9" y="9" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/>

defence.label: Armour
defence.meaning: fitted plating on the hull sections; takes damage before the hull and is restored at a yard
defence.svg: <rect x="5" y="5" width="14" height="14" rx="1"/><rect x="2" y="9" width="3" height="6"/><rect x="19" y="9" width="3" height="6"/><rect x="9" y="2" width="6" height="3"/>

defence.label: Hull
defence.meaning: the ship's own hit points, one pool per section; set by the design and restored only by repair

defence.label: Systems
defence.meaning: engines, guns, sensors and gear inside; hurt past a 0 hull section, or by electricity

defence.label: People
defence.meaning: captain and crew, and a living ship's bio systems; hurt past a 0 hull section, or by bio and fire past the shield
